title: β-galactosidase activity assay
author: Yuan Yao
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.qabdsan
materials: The absorbance at OD420 was measured

steps.title: Collect cells at defined OD
steps.instruction: Take 1 ml of exponentially growing cells cultured at 37 °C in ABTGcasa medium and collect samples when the culture reaches OD450 of 0.1, 0.2, 0.3, 0.4, or 0.5.

steps.title: Permeabilize cells with cold toluene
steps.instruction: Mix each 1 ml cell sample with 0.1 ml cold toluene and keep the mixture on ice immediately.

steps.title: Add Z buffer and substrate
steps.instruction: Transfer 0.2 ml of the toluene‑treated sample to 1 ml Z buffer (40 mM NaH2PO4, 60 mM Na2HPO4, 10 mM KCl, 1 mM MgSO4, 50 mM β‑mercaptoethanol, pH 7.0) that contains 0.66 mg/ml o‑nitrophenyl‑β‑D‑galactopyranoside.

steps.title: Incubate reaction at 30 °C
steps.instruction: Incubate the mixture at 30 °C until the solution turns yellow (monitor the color change).

steps.title: Stop reaction with Na2CO3
steps.instruction: Add 0.5 ml of 1 M Na2CO3 to terminate the reaction.

steps.title: Calculate β‑galactosidase activity
steps.instruction: Calculate activity using the formula: 1000 × OD420 / (reaction time in minutes) × OD450 × 0.2 ml.
